currency.basis: 2023 redesign confirmed in current use: official app updated 2026-09-29 ships the wordmark-centric identity; the base blue/yellow mark matches the retired design still mirrored by third-party icon libraries.

identity.basis: Candidate is the current Itaú Unibanco consumer mark (lowercase 'itaú' wordmark); identity corroborated by the official App Store listing and independent encyclopedic use.

assessment.independenceRationale: Official currency evidence (App Store listing) is independent of the vector host (Wikimedia Commons) and of the encyclopedic corroboration; the stale-library observation is a fourth independent party.
uncertainties: Current official iOS app icon shows a navy square on an orange field; the candidate uses the orange square with white 'itaú' variant used as the current logo by pt.wikipedia. The exact app-store color variant was not found as an original vector.

variant.basis: Orange rounded square with white 'itaú' — the wordmark is the mark itself (no separate standalone symbol exists in the current identity), so the letters forming the mark satisfy catalog suitability; accompanying-text rule does not apply.

candidate.rationale: Genuine original vector of the current 2023 design (orange square, white 'itaú' counterform wordmark), preserved byte-exact from the Commons upload; replaces the retired blue/yellow base mark with a supported evidenced update.

proposals.reason: The accepted base icon reproduces the retired blue/yellow Itaú mark (blue #1a5493 rounded square with yellow #fff212 bar) which the bank no longer uses; the current identity (2023 redesign, still shipped in the 2026-09-29 app update) is the lowercase 'itaú' wordmark on an orange field. A genuine original vector of the current design exists.

Icon raster (evidence only): orange field with navy rounded square and white lowercase 'itaú'. Confirms the current wordmark-centric design; raster is not a replacement source.
